title_sq: Shitet Apartament 1+1 tek Rezidenca Kodra e Diellit 1
description_sq: Shitet Apartament 1+1 tek Rezidenca Kodra e Diellit 1, ne katin e 2 te nje objekti te ri, i pajisur me ashensor. Apartamenti ka Sipërfaqe 63.5m2 neto dhe Sipërfaqe 70m2 bruto, e organizuar ne nje Ambjent ndenje + Kuzhinën e gatimit, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale, nje tualet, koridor dhe nje ballkon me pamje te lire. Apartamenti eshte i pershtatshem per nje cift, qe kerkon komoditet dhe qetesi. Cmimi i Apartamentit eshte 175’000€.
title_en: 1+1 Apartment for sale at Residence Kodra e Diellit 1
description_en: 1+1 Apartment for sale at Residence Kodra e Diellit 1, on the 2nd floor of a new building, equipped with an elevator. The apartment has a net area of ​​63.5m2 and a gross area of ​​70m2, organized in a living room + kitchen, a double bedroom, a toilet, a corridor and a balcony with a free view. The apartment is suitable for a couple looking for comfort and peace. The price of the Apartment is €175,000.
